There are no network calls, file operations, or commands that suggest data exfiltration, remote code execution, or tampering with system files outside the package scope.

No obfuscated code, suspicious downloads, or unexpected system modifications are present. The package adheres to standard AUR packaging practices and poses no evidence of supply-chain compromise.
